items.name: Booch
items.description: This vibrant green tea-based kombucha is a local specialty from the Tidewater Rock fortress in the dangerous seas of the southern Shackles, near Windward Isle. Crafted by combining island herbs with fermented tea, Booch serves to fortify sailors and sentries alike. Its tangy taste has a revitalizing quality, making it a popular drink among those who stand watch through the long nights. items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.name: Firearm Bullet
items.description: The ammunition of most one-handed and two-handed firearms, firearm bullets typically take the form of small balls of lead or some other metal. Thirty bullets weigh half a pound.

items.name: Tidewater Cutlass
items.description: The masterwork cutlass issued to the guards at Tidewater Rock in the Shackles is a finely crafted weapon, reflecting both the pride of the island's defenders and the treacherous seas surrounding it. Fashioned from polished steel with a sweeping guard engraved with nautical motifs, this cutlass is as much a symbol of status among the guards as it is a tool of their trade. Officers receive these weapons upon completing their training, and each blade bears the mark of the shipwrights who forged the

items.name: Tidewater Shipbreaker 32 Pounder
items.description: When Tidewater Rock was claimed in the Lady’s name, these cannons were the first things emplaced—before walls were finished or banners raised. Forged inland and hauled at ruinous cost, each gun was dragged into its stone cradle and fused to the rock with iron collars and spellbound mortar. Since then, no captain ignorant of the Lady’s leave has ever sailed past unchallenged—and few have sailed past unscathed.

items.name: Tidewater 1-tap
items.description:
Tidewater 1-TapMasterwork Lever-Action Rifle

Range: 120 ft.; Damage: 1d10 piercing; Critical: 20/x3; Capacity: 1
